name: Tacot Edit 0.2.3
body:
Preview audio works. The editor routed every clip through Web Audio, and Chromium mutes a MediaElementAudioSourceNode when the media comes from another origin — which is exactly what the asset protocol is. Previews now play straight from the media element, and export builds its own mixer from same-origin blob URLs so recordings keep their sound too.

Trimming is faster:

- Edge handles are bigger and always visible instead of appearing on hover
- `[` trims the clip start to the playhead, `]` trims the end
- The inspector has start/end trim buttons plus -1s and +1s end nudges
- Image clips are no longer limited to their 5 second source length
